description: Implement the full Report Builder tab with drag-and-drop field selection, report type selection, date range, grouping/aggregation options, report preview, and CSV export
steps: Implement src/components/reports/ReportBuilder.jsx with: (a) Report type selector - buttons or dropdown for nurse_pipeline_summary, compliance_status, placement_outcomes, cohort_progress, communication_activity. (b) Drag-and-drop field selection using @dnd-kit - a pool of available fields on the left (varies by report type) and a 'selected fields' drop zone on the right where users can reorder fields. (c) Date range selection with start/end date inputs. (d) Grouping/aggregation options as a select: by cohort, by stage, by facility, by month. (e) Generate Report button that computes report data from AppContext (nurses, cohorts, placements, communications). (f) Report preview table showing generated data. (g) Export CSV button that triggers a download. The component should use useAppContext() to access nurses, cohorts, placements, facilities, communications data.

For the drag-and-drop field selection, use DndContext and SortableContext from @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable. Create a draggable field chip component. Available fields per report type: nurse_pipeline_summary (Name, Stage, Score, Cohort, Specialty, Source), compliance_status (Name, Compliance %, Missing Docs, Expiring Docs), placement_outcomes (Nurse, Facility, Stage, Match Score, Start Date), cohort_progress (Cohort Name, Pass Rate, Placement Rate, Budget), communication_activity (Nurse, Channel, Type, Date, Status).

Ensure the report generation logic pulls real data from AppContext and filters it based on selected date range and grouping option. The grouping option should aggregate rows (e.g., 'by cohort' groups nurse pipeline rows by cohort and shows counts, 'by month' groups by the month of the relevant date).
Style with Tailwind CSS following the existing card/panel patterns (bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6). Use #5B2D8E brand color for active/selected states.
acceptance_criteria: Report Builder tab shows report type selection with 5 report types
Drag-and-drop field selection allows users to pick and reorder fields
Date range picker filters report data
Grouping selector offers by cohort, by stage, by facility, by month options
Generate Report button produces a preview table from real AppContext data
Export CSV button downloads a .csv file
verification: Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0
Run npm run lint and confirm no errors
